scope: Sequential fresh-process complete requests, same native tokens/noise seed; Genie lengths differ

limitations: Two hot samples per input and configuration; sequential runs without randomized order.
Native NumPy and ONNX FP32 output PCM is identical for both cases on each backend; other inputs are unverified.
Mixed FP16 changes waveform and is not quality-accepted by human listening or ASR.
Genie frontend, sampling and generated duration differ; latency does not establish equal-work speedup.
Sampled process-tree RSS and private bytes are different metrics, may overlap GPU shared allocations, and are not added.

wddm_validation.scope: Separate WDDM resource probe. Includes sampler overhead; do not replace end-to-end timing benchmark. Process-attributed counters may overlap process RSS and are not summed into total RAM.
wddm_validation.precision: CPU GPT FP32; DirectML acoustic vocoder mixed FP16
